description: Retrieve the Agent Nexus catalogue categories and their current counts of approved entries. Use this when you need to understand the taxonomy, learn the accepted 'category' values or prepare a catalogue exploration. The three interface layers are api, mcp and cli. Call once when category information is needed; this tool does not return individual services. Use discover_capabilities to find a service for a task, search_registry for a known keyword, or list_entries to enumerate entries. Read-only, idempotent and parameterless.
name: list_categories
title: List interface categories
